metaDescription: Shop custom Mercer Mettle sweaters and cardigans for your team. Perfect for corporate gifts and uniforms. Bulk orders at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Mercer Mettle sweaters and cardigans are known for their modern fit and soft, durable fabrics, making them a preferred choice for corporate apparel. Whether you need uniform cardigans for a retail team or embroidered crewnecks for a company event, these pieces offer a polished look that holds up to frequent wear. The open front cardigan style, for example, layers easily over any shirt and accepts left-chest embroidery cleanly, giving you a professional result every time.
